requirements.source: File 25 sections 25-28 as superseded by current central/File 20 ownership addenda
requirements.summary: File 25 owns canonical visual tokens and visual regression with Sabri Green #087A4E; File 20 retains structural shell widths, layout breakpoints, shell dimensions and mount geometry.

Founder/profile presentation routes, section routing, 404/410 boundaries and REST slug validation are implemented; File 03 UUID/public-ID versus File 25 slug canonical-alias parity remains an external staging acceptance gate.

Founder, verified Doctor and permitted Member presentation, hero, File 03 1.4.0 public-media URL/alt/focal projection, sections, native-owner actions and owner-only View-as-Public are implemented from authorized projections. Canonical owner cover focal coordinates render when present; the Hero includes a bounded brief introduction and truthful lifecycle/status surface. Preview modes public/member/mobile/desktop/rtl/contact/search/social remain noindex presentation-only surfaces and unavailable native actions hide rather than guess routes.

Federated read-only author timeline now combines File 21 publications plus enabled/available File 06 Knowledge, File 10 Video, File 11 Reels and File 12 PDF public projections. Built-in providers implement the complete §46 plan contract, filters expose only registered content types, deduplication/pagination/search/back restoration remain bounded, and non-zero pins require private audited actor/reason/reference/surface/start/end metadata with active time-window enforcement.

Reusable content/profile cards, public field allow-lists, safe destinations/media, Read More behavior, card variants and profile-local discovery presentation are implemented without native domain writes.
Loading, empty, warning, offline, error, suspended, deleted, corrected and retracted presentation states are represented without inventing native owner decisions.

requirements.source: File 25 sections 59-61 and Master Plan P-11
requirements.summary: Mobile-first responsive source, visible keyboard focus, touch-sized controls, explicit owner/admin RTL preview, bidi-aware presentation, reduced-motion and forced-colors preparation are implemented; real-device/browser assistive evidence remains a separate acceptance gate.

Bounded provider queries, pagination, fail-closed optional providers, no-store sensitive output, deterministic ETag/Last-Modified conditional reads and bounded public REST rate limiting are implemented.

requirements.source: File 25 section 64 and current File 24 governance boundary
requirements.summary: File 25 enforces secure rendering, same-site URLs and bounded module metadata while current File 24 remains security/privacy/compliance/resilience owner; advisory state requests do not grant File 25 security authority.

Canonical SEO presentation, privacy-safe public metrics and owner-only profile completion assistance are implemented. Completion evidence remains bound to canonical File 03 avatar alt metadata; public rendering may use a descriptive fallback but cannot fabricate completion evidence.

File 25 administrator configuration is nested under File 20 when available and now exposes only bounded settings with observable runtime effects. Governed sections include profile templates, timeline providers/default filter/page size/optional provider enablement, content-card density, visibility/metrics, responsive preview and SEO; accessibility, no-store cache policy, Safe Mode and diagnostics remain mandatory non-disableable controls.

Versioned public REST and component APIs use strict allow-lists, bounded pagination, permission callbacks, ETag/Last-Modified conditional reads, bounded public rate limiting, no private identifiers and sanitized component rendering.

Diagnostics, Site Health, Safe Mode and File25-only repair remain mandatory operational/recovery controls rather than presentation toggles. Presentation preferences cannot disable accessibility, Safe Mode or diagnostics, and no-store public profile caching remains fixed until an accepted cache-partition contract exists.
Schema upgrades are idempotent with stale-lock recovery, current companion structural contracts are verified, and uninstall remains non-destructive to native profiles/posts/domain data.

Role, profile-state, timeline-state, security, accessibility, companion-contract and adversarial source-level QA is governed through Reviews 20-694; the latest cycle specifically locks focal media fidelity, Hero/status completeness, RTL preview, portfolio timeline federation, complete provider-contract adoption and audited time-bounded pinning.

Visual-regression/browser/accessibility contracts and evidence schema are prepared; real browser/device, zoom, RTL/LTR, keyboard/touch/screen-reader and cross-module screenshot evidence remains pending on Hostinger staging.
Deterministic ZIP construction, manifest, checksum, exact current dependency matrix, duplicate/symlink/path/expansion defenses and independent artifact verification are implemented.
